description.value: Sima Sushi is a Japanese restaurant in Sechelt on BC's Sunshine Coast, serving sushi and Japanese cuisine. It offers both vegan and vegetarian menu options and is wheelchair accessible, making it a welcoming dining stop for cyclists traveling the Sunshine Coast corridor.
